business: Collabo (brand side): a self-serve marketplace where small businesses hire creators with escrow
by_segment: Local business owner (cafe, restaurant, gym, salon)
Marketing manager at a 10-50 person company
Founder of a small online (DTC) brand
why_not: I already book creators on a marketplace I know, and this one says right on the page that follower counts and results aren't verified. The escrow and promo codes are nice, but a lower fee doesn't make me switch when the thing I worry about most isn't solved.

Dropping $525 on one Reel from a creator whose follower counts and past results nobody has verified is a gamble I can't make on my budget, when I can put that same money into Meta ads and see ROAS within days. The promo code is nice, but it only tells me after the fact whether I wasted the money.

Collabstr already does this for me, and I'd have to start over with a brand-new marketplace that has no track record. The escrow and draft approval are nice, but they don't give me a reason to switch this week.

I already find creators by DMing them and I mostly pay in free product, not $500 cash. A marketplace built around paid cash packages doesn't match how I do this, and I'm not paying a fee on top for something I can do myself.

The escrow and promo code are smart, but this still leaves me picking creators, briefing them and approving drafts myself, which is exactly the work I don't have time for. And I'd be guessing whether a $500 Reel is a fair price, since the follower counts and results aren't verified.

My problem isn't finding or paying creators, I already DM them and Venmo them for nothing. My problem is I don't have time to manage them and approve drafts, and this still puts me in the middle of every draft and every live post.
why_yes: Twenty-five bucks to have my money held until I've seen the draft and the live post is cheaper than getting burned once by a creator I DM'd who ghosts me. I'd pull one $500 test out of my Meta budget and see if the promo code actually moves covers.
flip: Follower counts and past results verified straight from Instagram/TikTok, so I know the creator's numbers and track record are real before I put money in.
If I could post product-for-content (gifting) deals on it and still get the escrow and promo-code tracking, with verified follower counts.
Follower counts and audience stats pulled directly from Instagram/TikTok and verified, so I can see real reach and engagement before I pay.

Verified follower and sales data from past Collabo deals, like real promo-code redemptions per creator, plus cheaper starter packages around $100-150 so I can test one creator without risking a month of ad spend.
Follower counts and past results verified straight from Instagram/TikTok, plus a named, regulated escrow or payment provider holding the money, so I know I'd get it back even if Collabo disappeared.

Verified audience location and stats from Instagram, plus real promo-code redemption numbers from other local businesses like mine, so I could run one cheap test with a local creator and compare it to my Meta cost per customer.
Follower counts and past results verified by Instagram or TikTok, plus a small seller I recognize in my niche saying they got sales from it.
Verified follower counts plus real promo-code redemption numbers from other local cafes or salons in my city, ideally with a cheaper local creator under $200 so I can test it once.
Follower counts and past results verified straight from Instagram/TikTok, so I know the creator's numbers are real before my money goes into escrow.
A verified local creator with a cheaper starter package, say under $200, plus results from another small business in my city showing actual promo code redemptions.
Follower and engagement numbers pulled directly from Instagram/TikTok with a fake-follower check, so I can trust a creator without doing my own audit.
Verified audience data showing how many of a creator's followers are in my city, plus real promo-code redemption numbers from past deals with businesses like mine.
Follower and engagement numbers pulled straight from Instagram/TikTok and verified, plus a way to offer free product or a small cash-plus-product deal instead of $500 up front.
Follower and engagement numbers verified straight from Instagram or TikTok, plus a few smaller creators under $200 so I can test once without betting half my ad budget.
Verified follower and sales data pulled straight from Instagram/TikTok, plus a bigger pool of creators in my niche than my current platform has.

Verified follower and sales numbers pulled straight from Instagram, plus local creators in my city who take small deals ($100-$200) or free product, so it saves me the time of DMing people one by one.
Verified local audience numbers and promo-code results from other cafes in my city showing real redemptions, plus creators under $200 so it fits what I already spend.
If Collabo picked two or three vetted creators for my niche and budget, so I only had to approve one draft and watch the promo code sales in the evening.

If it took the managing off my plate, like a creator who's done great work for brands like mine handling it end to end where I only glance at the final post, or verified results so I could trust a creator without vetting them myself.
